name: Easy Obby but you get banned if you die!
desc:
🎮 Easy Obby but you get BANNED if you DIE! 😱

Welcome to the easiest obby you’ll ever play... or so you think 👀

😈 One mistake and you're OUT – die once, and you're BANNED for 20 seconds!
💀 Fall off? Miss a jump? Say goodbye… (temporarily).
💾 Your stage is automatically saved, even if you leave or get banned!

But don’t worry — skilled players get rewarded!
✨ Complete stages to earn COINS!
💰 Use your coins to REDUCE your ban time... or stack them up for bragging rights.
🔥 Come back after your ban and get a special bonus reward — loyalty pays off!

🎯 Can you beat the obby without a single fail?
🏆 Challenge your friends and prove who’s the REAL obby master.

💡 It's simple. It's fun. It's brutal. Are you in?

🔮 Premium players get a chat tag, more coming soon! 🔮
